text:
deploy-bot: finished staged rollout -> quant-v2 to 100% traffic (us + eu). initiating post-deploy synthetic checks.

marta: EU synthetic prefill probe showing elevated error rate starting 09:12 UTC. p50 healthy, p95 spikes with 502/504. attaching quick probe output. :mag:

aj: can you paste the failing payload and probe command?

marta: probe uses /v1/generate with small prompt to exercise prefix cache warmup. curl: `curl -s -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"model":"quant-v2-eu","input":"prefill test"}' | jq -r .status`  -> returns `error` w/ body `upstream reset` in 6/10 samples.

lee: interesting — timeline aligns with kv-prefill background job kicking off on eu1. any oom/kern logs?

marta: proxy logs show `connection reset by peer` and `read tcp: connection reset` from model-hosts. grabbing dmesg now.

sre-bot: alert -> INC-279455: eu1 synth 5xx cluster spike. paging SRE.

aj: options: (A) full rollback to quant-v1 globally, (B) region pin (route eu -> quant-v1), (C) reduce concurrency/slow-warmup and re-deploy quant-v2 to eu only. prefer B for fastest mitigation.

lee: agree with regional pin. low customer impact and keeps US on new version. also enable reduced-concurrency profile on eu cluster to avoid thrash while we triage.

deploy-bot: executing traffic update: eu route -> quant-v1 (manual hold). concurrency-profile set to "reduced-warmup" for quant-v2 eu hosts.

marta: probe returned to baseline within 2m after pin. p95 back to normal. :white_check_mark:

aj: created short release note: "EU traffic temporarily pinned to quant-v1 due to synthetic probe 5xx spike post quant-v2 rollout. Investigating kv-prefill/warmup behavior. Will update." Posting to #release-notes and incident.

lee: triage plan: 1) collect model runtime heap/alloc stats from eu1 2) run isolated quant-v2 canary with extended warmup and prefix-prefill 3) compare kernel vs userspace resets.

marta: uploaded logs to INC-279455 and added probe traces + sampling. initial noise points to increased memory churn during prefill rounds.

aj: let's keep auto-unpin disabled. If we find a quick config fix (increase prefill throttling) we can try targeted hotpatch to eu1. otherwise plan staged re-rollout with telemetry gating.

sre-bot: incident severity S2. oncall acknowledged.

lee: I'll start host-level checks (oom-kill, NIC flaps) and see if there's disk pressure causing swap.

marta: thanks, will coordinate with infra for hotpatch window. keeping this thread as coordination.

(END)
